## Purpose
`/workflows/archived`: archived workflows. They can be restored (unarchived) or permanently deleted, singly or in bulk.

## Responsibilities
`ArchivedWorkflowsPage`:
- reads `workflowsApi.list` (archived);
- search and sort;
- `WorkflowCard`s;
- `unarchive`: "Workflow restored.";
- `remove`, including bulk.

Titled "Archived workflows — Agentic AI Design Patterns".
